2026-2027.summary: This week's Broadway League data—drawn from six national records, above the typical monthly count—signals strengthening demand across the touring circuit. *Oh, Mary!* surged dramatically to $1.87M (an 800% week-over-week gain and an all-time high), while *Operation Mincemeat* and *Hell's Kitchen* showed divergent trajectories, with the former climbing 44% to a new peak of $1.12M and the latter declining 30%. *Waitress* has not reported for 224 consecutive weeks; confirmation with booking partners is advisable.
